companyProfile.companyDescription: Tata Steel Limited is an India-based global steel company. The Company and its subsidiaries have presence across the entire value chain of steel manufacturing from mining and processing iron ore and coal to producing and distributing finished products. The Company offers a range of steel products including a portfolio of high value-added downstream products such as hot rolled, cold rolled, coated steel, rebars, wire rods, tubes and wires. Its segments include Tata Steel India, Neelachal Ispat Nigam Limited, Other Indian Operations, Tata Steel Netherlands Operations, Tata Steel UK Operations, Other Trade Related Operations, South East Asian Operations and Rest of the World. It serves customers across diverse markets including construction and infrastructure, construction retail, automotive and ancillaries, energy, engineering goods, packaging, and downstream. Its products include Automotive Steels, Galvano, Tata Agrico (Agriculture, Construction, and Hand Tools), Tata Astrum and others.

recentNews.headline: ICICI Prudential Large Cap Fund portfolio: 3 new stocks added, GAIL among 4 exits in June
recentNews.summary: India's largest large cap mutual fund shuffled its portfolio in June by adding three stocks and exiting four. Tata Steel saw the biggest increase in holdings, while GAIL featured among the complete exits.

recentNews.headline: Tata Steel share price dips nearly 1% after Q1FY27 business update; details here
recentNews.summary: Tata Steel shares hit their 52-week high of ₹224.40 on 15 May this year after hitting a 52-week low of ₹152.55 on 1 August last year. Over the last one year, the metal stock has gained 18% compared to an 8% fall in the benchmark Sensex.

recentNews.headline: Tata Steel Netherlands summoned by Dutch prosecutors over pollution violations
recentNews.summary: Dutch prosecutors suspect Tata Steel of multiple criminal offence, including unlawful release of harmful substances into the air, failing in its duty of care by carrying out insufficient maintenance

recentNews.headline: Stocks to buy for short term: Tata Steel, Raymond Realty among 5 stocks experts recommend for next 1-2 weeks
recentNews.summary: Discover which stocks analysts are banking on for quick gains. From Tata Steel's rebound to Raymond Realty's breakout, this article highlights the top five stock picks that are attracting bullish sentiment in the market.

recentNews.headline: Stocks to buy for short term: Maruti, Tata Steel among 3 shares Anand Rathi's Jigar Patel recommends for next 1-2 weeks
recentNews.summary: Anand Rathi’s Jigar Patel recommends buying three stocks, including Maruti Suzuki and Tata Steel, for the next 1-2 weeks. Learn how technical analysis supports these picks and the market's bullish outlook.

recentNews.headline: Tata Steel pushes UK profitability target to FY29
recentNews.summary: Tata Steel chairman N. Chandrasekaran says the UK business is expected to become Ebitda- and PAT-positive by FY29.

recentNews.headline: India launches anti-dumping probe into hot-rolled flat steel imports from China, Japan and Russia
recentNews.summary: The probe was launched following an application filed by JSW Steel, JSW Vijayanagar Metallics and Jindal Steel Odisha. The application has also received support from Tata Steel and SAIL

recentNews.headline: Stocks to watch: IRFC, Tata Steel, Vedanta among shares in focus today; check list here
recentNews.summary: Stock market today: On Thursday, the Nifty 50 climbed 0.83% to finish at 24,021, and the Sensex rose 1% to close at 76,991.

recentNews.headline: ‘I have noted your request…’: Ratan Tata’s kindness in a simple email to an intern wins hearts online
recentNews.summary: A LinkedIn post by entrepreneur Sneha Biswas has gone viral after she shared an email she received from Ratan Tata while interning at Tata Steel in 2020. Along with the screenshot, Biswas recalled missing a meeting with the industrialist and described it as a regret that has stayed with her.
